messages:
rachel (Finance): Flagging a partner request from ChannelCore about how we classified prorated credits on invoice AWS-INV-77890. They say credits were booked as 'marketing discounts' and want them reclassified to 'sales rebates' for tax reporting. Est reclassification amount USD 3,450 for Apr prorates. @dan @mike please advise.
dan (Partner Ops): Partner sent official note this morning and attached reseller agreement excerpt that specifies credits should be sales rebates when passed through. Link: https://redwood.internal/drive/channelcore-reclassify-apr.pdf
mike (Sales): FYI partner is pushing because their tax team flagged it for Q2 filing. They want us to issue a formal credit memo with GL change.
billing-bot: Queried invoice lines. Prorate credit line ID: PR-3344, amount USD 3,450, currently posted GL 5120 (Marketing Discounts). Created ticket FIN-3785.
rachel (Finance): Tax impact could be material, loop in Nina. If we reclassify after close we may need a journal re-post. Need authoritative partner instruction and Finance Lead approval.
nina (Tax): Need to review the reseller agreement and the flow. If credits meet the definition of a sales rebate (reducing revenue) we should reclassify to GL 4215. Please provide evidence partner requested pass-through and that Redwood acted as pass-through.
dan (Partner Ops): Attached email: partner email and signed excerpt uploaded to drive above. They got the credits on Apr 14 and confirmed pass-through in the chain.
paul (RevOps): Proposed steps: 1) Draft credit memo to partner reflecting GL change 2) Post reversing entry and repost to GL 4215 with note "per partner reclassification request" 3) Attach FIN-3785 and partner evidence. Approval required from Finance Lead.
rachel (Finance): Draft credit memo text below. Approvers: @yasmin (Finance Lead), @nina (Tax).

``
Credit memo to ChannelCore (partner id CC-21)
Amount: USD 3,450
Reason: Reclassification of prorated partner credit from marketing discount to sales rebate per reseller agreement and partner request (affects tax reporting).
Related invoice: AWS-INV-77890
Original GL: 5120
New GL: 4215
Internal ticket: FIN-3785
Attachments: partner email + reseller agreement excerpt
``

yasmin (Finance Lead): Approved pending Tax confirmation. @nina please confirm classification. :white_check_mark:
nina (Tax): Reviewed attachments. Partner passes credits to end-customers and agreement language supports rebate treatment. Approve reclassification to GL 4215. Note: include memo for external audit trail.
paul (RevOps): Executing journal reclassification and creating credit memo. Will tag entries with "adj: FIN-3785" and attach partner evidence. ETA for posting: 2 business days.
billing-bot: Reclassification journal created: JRL-9902. Credit memo drafted and queued. Sent notice to AWS settlement ops if their involvement needed.
rachel (Finance): I'll update month-close notes and mark as "reclassified per partner request, pending memo". Thanks team.
dan (Partner Ops): Notifying partner of approval and ETA. :thumbsup:
